title: Apply successor synthesis to linear solve
summary: Applied shared successor synthesis to the live linear solve by splitting the semantic subtraction operator from its operand, authoring material-input/catalyst/target roles, excluding the catalyst from result lineage, compiling and caching the measured successor plan, replacing bespoke merge motion with shared sampling, preserving rigid continuants and KaTeX metrics, exposing inspectable editor roles, and refining live handoff timing from checkpoint-frame review.
